title: Quote
summary: A testimonial or pull quote: your own blockquote, with a caption for the portrait, name, role and rating. The element draws a figure and figcaption around your markup and never changes it; before it upgrades (or with JavaScript off) the plain blockquote shows.

props.name: cite
props.description: The source URL (a same-site path or http(s) address). Renders one Source link in the caption; your own blockquote cite attribute is untouched.

props.name: size
props.description: large sets bigger type for a lone hero quote.

slots.name: portrait
slots.description: A pk-avatar or image beside the name.

slots.name: role
slots.description: Their role or context, under the name.

parts.name: figure
parts.description: The figure around the quote and its caption.

parts.name: caption
parts.description: The figcaption row; hidden when it has nothing to show.

parts.name: source
parts.description: The Source link when cite is set.

cssProperties.name: --pk-quote-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the quote and its caption.

a11y: A figure with a figcaption around your blockquote, so the attribution belongs to the quote. The portrait is named by pk-avatar and the rating keeps its own label, so each is spoken once. The element adds no hover-only content and never edits the nodes you wrote.
